audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Swain five of seven stages while the prose beneath it calls levels 2-5 neutral, calls level 6 your shift, and says Sunfire moves extended trades in your favour.
audit.why: The whys and the chart disagree with each other in the same view. The packet stage read matches the prose.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Swain / Swain / Skill / Skill / Sejuani / Skill / Skill in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes named Nevermove, Glacial Prison and Demonic Ascension without a single range or cooldown.
audit.why: Glacial Prison reaches 1300 and Nevermove only 850 — that 450-unit gap is literally why level 6 is the spike, and it was left as 'outranges'. Demonic Ascension is a flat 120s at every rank and Nevermove is 12s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: 1300 vs 850 written into the level-6 spike and whys[4]; Demonic Ascension's 120s and Nevermove's 12s written into the phases and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Glacial Prison is described as a root in three fields, and 'Permafrost stacks' is used for what are Frost stacks in three more.
audit.why: Glacial Prison stuns the first champion hit; the storm slows the rest. Permafrost is the E stun that fires once Frost stacks cap — Winter's Wrath is what applies the stacks. Naming the stacks after the finisher makes the combo unreadable.
audit.corrected: 'Root' replaced with 'stun' throughout; 'Permafrost stacks' replaced with Frost stacks applied by Winter's Wrath.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nevermove's return pass and Fury of the North's shatter were absent.
audit.why: Riot's text is explicit: the wave 'then returns to Swain and roots enemies it hits' — the outgoing pass does not root, so the dodge is two sidesteps, and walking toward Swain beats the recall. And Sejuani's passive shatters a stunned enemy for massive magic damage, which is the actual payoff of the Permafrost chain, never mentioned here.
audit.corrected: Return-pass root written into whys[0], spikes[0] and wants.foe[0]; the passive shatter written into mid as the reason the chain hurts.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal timing despite Ravenous Flock being his engine.
audit.why: Ravenous Flock heals and permanently grows his max health off soul fragments, so Grievous Wounds decides every extended trade.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds written into mid alongside the Demonic Ascension clock.

edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 stay neutral — his drain poke and Vision of Empire keep you honest, and you lack the burst to kill him before Ravenous Flock heals him back. Track Demonic Ascension's flat 120 seconds: once it is active, disengage and wait it out rather than fighting into sustained AOE drain, and buy Grievous Wounds as soon as you can. Level 6 is your real shift — Glacial Prison throws 1300 against his 850 Nevermove, so you open from a distance he cannot answer. The pattern is R stun, Q in, W twice, Permafrost: damaging a stunned target shatters it with Fury of the North, and he cannot drain while CC-locked.
edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 stay neutral — his drain poke and W bomb keep you honest, and you lack the burst to kill him before Demonic Ascension heals him back. Track his R cooldown: once Demonic Ascension is active, disengage and wait it out rather than fighting into sustained AOE drain. Level 6 is your real shift — Glacial Prison throws past his E range, so you can open a trade at distance he cannot initiate from. The pattern is R root at range, Q in, W twice, E shatter: the full chain deals real damage and he cannot drain while CC-locked. Force this trade when your HP allows and his R is down.

notes: Three fields called Glacial Prison a root — it is a stun on the first champion hit, with the storm slowing everyone else — and three more called Frost stacks 'Permafrost stacks', which hides the fact that Winter's Wrath is what applies them. The two facts worth the most here were both absent: Nevermove roots on its RETURN pass (so the dodge is two sidesteps and walking toward Swain beats the recall), and Fury of the North shatters a stunned target for massive magic damage, which is the entire payoff of the Permafrost chain.
